types.name: ApiVersion
types.description:
A version of the Shopify API. Each version has a unique handle in date-based format (YYYY-MM) or `unstable` for the development version.

Shopify guarantees supported versions are stable. Unsupported versions include unstable and release candidate versions. Use the [`publicApiVersions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/current/queries/publicApiVersions) query to retrieve all available versions. Learn more about [Shopify API versioning](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning).

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: The human-readable name of the version.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: The unique identifier of an ApiVersion. All supported API versions have a date-based (YYYY-MM) or `unstable` handle.

fields.name: supported
fields.description: Whether the version is actively supported by Shopify. Supported API versions are guaranteed to be stable. Unsupported API versions include unstable, release candidate versions. For more information, refer to [Versioning](https://shopify.dev/api/usage/versioning).
